title: Shard Checksums
description: Checksums every shard's data and metadata so corruption in one shard is detected without scanning the others. Per-shard checksums localize damage: the system knows exactly which shard needs healing.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Replica Quorum Repair
description: Repairs a damaged shard from its replicas only after a quorum agrees on the correct data, preventing a single bad replica from spreading corruption. Quorum repair trades a little latency for strong correctness.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Shard Rebalancing
description: Moves key ranges between shards to even out size and load, running as a background migration that never blocks reads or writes. Rebalancing keeps the cluster balanced as data grows unevenly.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Shard Split and Merge
description: Splits shards that outgrow their bounds and merges shards that shrink, keeping shard count matched to data size automatically. Split/merge is the cluster's growth mechanism: no manual resharding projects.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Hot-Shard Detection
description: Detects shards receiving disproportionate traffic - the hot shard problem - from request-rate metrics, before they melt. Detection triggers mitigation: caching, splitting, or replica scaling for that key range.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Consistent Hashing
description: Maps keys to shards on a hash ring so adding or removing a shard moves only a fraction of keys. Consistent hashing is what makes elastic scaling practical: the cluster grows without a full data reshuffle.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Shard Snapshots
description: Takes point-in-time snapshots per shard independently, so backup and restore parallelize across the cluster. Per-shard snapshots also enable surgical recovery of just the damaged shard.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Cross-Shard Repair
description: Repairs shards using erasure-coded fragments stored across other shards, so even the loss of whole shards is recoverable without full replicas. Cross-shard repair trades storage efficiency for recovery flexibility.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Version Vectors
description: Tracks causality across shard replicas with version vectors, distinguishing concurrent updates from stale ones. Vectors let the system merge concurrent writes correctly instead of last-write-wins data loss.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Anti-Entropy
description: Runs background Merkle-tree comparisons between replicas and repairs divergent branches, guaranteeing replicas converge without operator intervention. Anti-entropy is the immune system of replicated storage.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Shard Placement
description: Places shard replicas across failure domains - racks, zones, regions - so one disaster cannot take all copies. Placement constraints are declared, and the scheduler proves they hold continuously.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Failure-Domain Spread
description: Ensures no two replicas of a shard share a failure domain, bounding the blast radius of any single failure. Spread is verified at write time: a write that would violate spread is rerouted.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Shard Migration
description: Moves shards between nodes online with a careful handoff - copy, dual-write, cutover - so migration never drops writes. Online migration enables hardware refreshes and evacuations with zero downtime.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Read Repair
description: Fixes stale replicas encountered during normal reads by writing the freshest value back, healing the cluster as a side effect of serving traffic. Read repair means popular data self-heals fastest - exactly where correctness matters most.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Shard Health Scoring
description: Scores each shard's health from latency, error rate, and replica lag, driving automated remediation before users suffer. Health scores turn a thousand-shard cluster from unmanageable into a sorted to-do list.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
